rules.v: Recruiters must be licensed and can be sanctioned, but are not jointly liable for the employer's obligations
rules.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin dan dapat dikenai sanksi, tetapi tidak bertanggung jawab bersama atas kewajiban majikan
rules.n: Placement companies (P3MI) need a licence (SIP3MI) and a deposit and are liable for placement duties and sanctions; the 2017 Law does not make them jointly liable with the employer for wages abroad.

rules.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
rules.v: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
rules.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
rules.n: Workers may not be charged placement costs in law (Art. 30), but BP2MI Regulation 9/2020 exempts only ten occupations (among them domestic workers, caregivers, farm workers, fishing crew and drivers); implementation was postponed in 2021 for lack of funding, and fees in other occupations follow destination cost structures.
rules.s: Law 18/2017 Art. 30; BP2MI Reg. 9/2020; BP2MI Decision 214/2021

rules.v: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
rules.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
rules.n: A placement agreement and an employment contract must be signed before departure; contracts are verified by the mission in the destination country.

rules.v: Orientation on rights and complaint channels is compulsory and free of charge to the worker
rules.vi: Orientasi tentang hak dan saluran pengaduan wajib dan gratis bagi pekerja
rules.n: Pre-departure orientation (OPP) is compulsory and run by the government; the 2017 Law lists it among costs the worker does not bear.

rules.v: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
rules.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.n: Compulsory BPJS Ketenagakerjaan coverage for work accidents and death before, during and after placement, with benefits for repatriation and failed placement; missions provide legal assistance.

rules.fi: Atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
rules.v: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
rules.vi: Undang-undang mewajibkan atase tenaga kerja atau kesejahteraan di perwakilan negara tujuan utama
rules.n: The 2017 Law requires the government to place labor attachés in missions in destination countries.

rules.v: Complaints lead to administrative sanctions or refunds of fees, but compensation needs the ordinary courts
rules.vi: Pengaduan menghasilkan sanksi administratif atau pengembalian biaya, tetapi ganti rugi memerlukan pengadilan umum
rules.n: Disputes are settled by deliberation, then through the courts; KP2MI and the Ministry impose administrative sanctions on P3MI, and Law 21/2007 provides criminal remedies and restitution for trafficking.

rules.f: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
rules.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
rules.v: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
rules.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
rules.n: Minimum age 18. Since 2015 placement of workers with individual employers (domestic work) in 19 Middle Eastern countries has been halted, except through a pilot one-channel system; reports in 2023 that the halt was lifted are contradicted by later official statements, so its status is to be confirmed. The rule is sex-neutral on its face, although almost all domestic workers are women.
rules.s: Manpower Decision 260/2015; Manpower Decision 291/2018; Antara and Bisnis.com, 2023–2025

rules.v: A statute assigns a public body the duty to provide reintegration services (employment, financial, psychosocial) to returning workers
rules.vi: Undang-undang memberi badan publik kewajiban menyediakan layanan reintegrasi (kerja, keuangan, psikososial) bagi pekerja yang pulang
rules.n: Central and district governments must provide social and economic empowerment for returning workers and their families; KP2MI runs reintegration programs.

rules.f: Shelter for workers in distress abroad
rules.fi: Tempat penampungan bagi pekerja bermasalah di luar negeri
rules.v: Shelters or safe houses are run at some missions by policy or practice
rules.vi: Tempat penampungan dikelola di sebagian perwakilan berdasarkan kebijakan atau praktik
rules.n: Missions run shelters for citizens in distress as part of citizen protection; no statutory duty to maintain them was found in Law 18/2017.
rules.s: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, citizen protection; Law 18/2017

rules.v: An official line exists but not around the clock, or only at some missions
rules.vi: Saluran resmi ada tetapi tidak 24 jam, atau hanya di sebagian perwakilan
rules.n: KP2MI runs a crisis center and complaint channels; round-the-clock operation is not confirmed.

rules.v: A statute provides or funds legal assistance for workers abroad, including in criminal and civil proceedings
rules.vi: Undang-undang menyediakan atau membiayai bantuan hukum bagi pekerja di luar negeri, termasuk dalam perkara pidana dan perdata
rules.n: Protection during work includes legal assistance and advocacy by the government and missions.

rules.v: Gender-specific measures rest on policy or programs
rules.vi: Langkah khusus gender bertumpu pada kebijakan atau program
rules.n: The 2017 Law states general principles of non-discrimination and gender equality; services for women survivors rest on programs with the women's empowerment ministry.

rules.fi: Kematian di luar negeri: pemulangan dan pemeriksaan
rules.v: Repatriation and a death benefit are provided, without a route to establish the cause of death
rules.vi: Pemulangan dan santunan kematian diberikan, tanpa jalur untuk memastikan sebab kematian
rules.n: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan pays death benefits and the government repatriates remains; no procedure for an independent examination of the cause of death was found.

rules.fi: UU antiperdagangan orang yang mencakup kerja
rules.v: A dedicated statute criminalizes trafficking for forced labor and provides victim assistance, protection or restitution
rules.vi: UU khusus memidanakan perdagangan orang untuk kerja paksa dan menyediakan bantuan, pelindungan atau restitusi bagi korban
rules.n: Law 21/2007 criminalizes trafficking for exploitation including forced labor, with restitution and witness and victim protection.

rules.n: Employment contract signed before departure in front of the placement agency.

Right to work and equal treatment

decisions.nm: Decision 127/PUU-XXI/2023 (fishing crew under the migrant worker protection law)
decisions.pe: Some groups asked the Constitutional Court to remove ship crew and fishers from Indonesia’s law protecting migrant workers. The Court said no. Indonesians who work on foreign fishing and merchant ships stay protected by that law.
decisions.pi: Sejumlah pihak meminta Mahkamah Konstitusi mengeluarkan awak kapal dan pelaut perikanan dari UU pelindungan pekerja migran. MK menolak. Warga Indonesia yang bekerja di kapal ikan dan kapal niaga asing tetap dilindungi undang-undang itu.

decisions.nm: Decision 019-020/PUU-III/2005 (education requirement for workers going abroad)
decisions.pe: Associations of placement companies and an NGO challenged parts of the 2004 law on sending workers abroad. The Court struck down the rule that every worker must have finished junior high school, because schooling can only be required when the job needs it. The other challenges failed.
decisions.pi: Asosiasi perusahaan penempatan dan sebuah yayasan menguji sejumlah ketentuan UU 39/2004. Mahkamah membatalkan ketentuan bahwa setiap calon TKI wajib berpendidikan sekurang-kurangnya SLTP, karena syarat pendidikan hanya dapat dibenarkan apabila pekerjaan memang memerlukannya. Permohonan lainnya ditolak.

decisions.nm: Decision 028-029/PUU-IV/2006 (minimum age of 21 for work with private employers abroad)
decisions.pe: Women aged 18 to 20 were refused departure because they were under 21, the minimum age for working in a private household abroad. They asked the Constitutional Court to strike the rule down. A narrow majority refused: the Court said the age limit protects workers and does not stop anyone from working.
decisions.pi: Sejumlah perempuan berusia 18 sampai 20 tahun ditolak berangkat karena belum berusia 21 tahun, batas usia minimum untuk bekerja pada pengguna perseorangan di luar negeri. Mereka meminta Mahkamah Konstitusi membatalkan ketentuan tersebut. Mayoritas tipis hakim menolak: menurut Mahkamah, batas usia tersebut melindungi…

decisions.nm: Decision 5/PUU-XI/2013 (challenge to Law 39/2004, Art. 60, by a former worker's brother)
decisions.pe: A man asked the Court to review a rule of the 2004 migrant worker law on behalf of his sister, a former migrant worker. The Court did not look at the rule itself, because he could not show he had the right to act for her.
decisions.pi: Seorang laki-laki meminta Mahkamah menguji salah satu ketentuan UU 39/2004 atas nama saudara perempuannya, seorang mantan TKI. Mahkamah tidak memeriksa pokok perkara karena Pemohon tidak dapat membuktikan bahwa ia berhak bertindak atas nama saudaranya.

decisions.nm: Decision 50/PUU-XI/2013 (renewing a contract without first going home)
decisions.pe: Women domestic workers from Cianjur challenged a rule forcing workers with household employers to come home before they could renew their contract. The Court struck the rule down: a protection law should not take away a worker's chance to stay with an employer she wants to keep working for.
decisions.pi: Para pekerja rumah tangga migran perempuan dari Cianjur menguji ketentuan yang mewajibkan TKI pada pengguna perseorangan pulang terlebih dahulu sebelum memperpanjang perjanjian kerja. Mahkamah membatalkan ketentuan tersebut: undang-undang perlindungan tidak boleh menghilangkan kesempatan pekerja untuk tetap bekerja…

decisions.nm: Decision 61/PUU-XIII/2015 (placement rules behind the Middle East moratorium)
decisions.pe: A placement company, a former worker in Riyadh and a woman who could not leave because of the halt on placements to the Middle East challenged the rules behind it. The Court upheld them, saying the rules aim to protect workers.
decisions.pi: Sebuah perusahaan penempatan, seorang mantan TKI di Riyadh, dan seorang calon TKI yang tidak dapat berangkat karena penghentian penempatan ke Timur Tengah menguji ketentuan yang menjadi dasarnya. Mahkamah menolak permohonan tersebut karena ketentuan itu bertujuan melindungi pekerja.

decisions.pe: Six seafarers argued that the card required of workers going abroad was a burden that did not fit their work. The Court disagreed: the card is one of the ways the state protects workers before, during and after work abroad.
decisions.pi: Enam orang pelaut berpendapat bahwa kartu yang diwajibkan bagi TKI merupakan beban yang tidak sesuai dengan pekerjaan mereka. Mahkamah tidak sependapat: kartu tersebut merupakan salah satu bentuk perlindungan negara sebelum, selama, dan sesudah bekerja di luar negeri.

decisions.nm: Decision 12/PUU-XIV/2016 (settling disputes between workers and placement companies)
decisions.pe: The head of a union of Indonesian overseas workers said the law's dispute rules left workers without a way to court against their placement company. The Court said the rule itself is valid and that any failure lies in how it is applied.
decisions.pi: Ketua serikat pekerja Indonesia luar negeri berpendapat bahwa ketentuan penyelesaian perselisihan dalam undang-undang membuat pekerja tidak memiliki jalan ke pengadilan untuk menggugat perusahaan penempatan. Mahkamah menyatakan ketentuan tersebut sah dan bahwa kekurangannya terletak pada pelaksanaannya.

decisions.nm: Decision 32/PUU-XV/2017 (meaning of 'exploitation' in the trafficking law)
decisions.pe: A man prosecuted under the anti-trafficking law argued that it was unfair to convict without proof of actual exploitation. The Court said the law is clear: the crime is complete when the acts are done for the purpose of exploitation, and his complaint was about the evidence in his own case.
decisions.pi: Seorang laki-laki yang dituntut berdasarkan UU TPPO berpendapat bahwa tidak adil menghukum seseorang tanpa bukti eksploitasi yang nyata. Mahkamah menyatakan undang-undang tersebut jelas: tindak pidana telah selesai ketika perbuatan dilakukan dengan tujuan eksploitasi, dan keberatan Pemohon menyangkut pembuktian dalam…

decisions.nm: Decision 83/PUU-XVII/2019 (capital and deposit rules for placement companies)
decisions.pe: The association of placement companies said the high capital and deposit rules of the 2017 law shut small agencies out. A narrow majority upheld the rules, which help make sure agencies can answer for what happens to the workers they send.
decisions.pi: Asosiasi perusahaan penempatan berpendapat bahwa kewajiban modal dan deposito yang tinggi dalam UU 18/2017 menyingkirkan perusahaan kecil. Mayoritas tipis hakim mempertahankan ketentuan tersebut, yang membantu memastikan perusahaan penempatan dapat bertanggung jawab atas pekerja yang dikirimnya.

decisions.nm: Decision 20/PUU-XVIII/2020 (bank deposit required of placement companies)
decisions.pe: Directors of two placement companies challenged the bank deposit rule. The Court kept it, as it had in a decision the same day.
decisions.pi: Direktur dua perusahaan penempatan menguji ketentuan deposito di bank. Mahkamah mempertahankannya, sebagaimana dalam putusan yang diucapkan pada hari yang sama.

decisions.nm: Decision 40/PUU-IX/2011 (exit ban during a preliminary investigation)
decisions.pe: Six advocates challenged the power to stop people leaving the country before they are even suspects. The Court agreed and removed it, so a ban on leaving now needs at least a formal criminal investigation.
decisions.pi: Enam advokat menguji kewenangan mencegah orang keluar negeri sebelum ia ditetapkan sebagai tersangka. Mahkamah mengabulkan permohonan tersebut sehingga pencegahan ke luar negeri kini sekurang-kurangnya memerlukan tahap penyidikan.

decisions.pe: A law professor under a travel ban challenged the rule that let the ban be renewed again and again. The Court removed the words 'each time', so renewals now have a limit.
decisions.pi: Seorang guru besar yang dicegah ke luar negeri menguji ketentuan yang memungkinkan pencegahan diperpanjang berkali-kali. Mahkamah membatalkan frasa “setiap kali” sehingga perpanjangan kini dibatasi.

help.di: Organisasi advokasi untuk pekerja migran Indonesia. Menangani kasus perorangan dan bekerja dengan desa yang banyak mengirim pekerja ke luar negeri.

help.nm: KP2MI (Ministry for the Protection of Indonesian Migrant Workers)
help.de: The government body that licenses recruitment agencies and receives complaints against them. Use its official website for the current complaint channel.
help.di: Lembaga pemerintah yang memberi izin kepada perusahaan penempatan (P3MI) dan menerima pengaduan terhadapnya. Gunakan situs resminya untuk saluran pengaduan terbaru.
